title: agy worker result envelope
description: Contract every agy worker job must satisfy. Shape only — Codex verifies truth independently.

status.description: Worker's own claim. Never trusted without independent verification.

summary.description: What was done, in plain prose.

files_changed.description: Every file created/modified/deleted. Checked against git diff by the QA gate.

commands_run.description: Worker-reported shell activity. Bounded workers leave this empty; the hardened gate never executes these strings.

tests_run.description: Worker-reported test claims. The hardened gate never executes these commands; bounded workers leave this empty and the driver supplies --verify.

risks.description: Anything the worker believes could break. Empty array is a valid answer, omission is not.

confidence.description: Self-reported. Treated as a routing hint only, never as evidence.

requires_human.description: True if the worker hit anything needing a human decision.
